title: Gca Bay Area Ras Garba - Oct 23rd By Aanal & Achal Anjaria Team - Sharda Musical Group
description: A Night of Traditional Gujarati Celebration at GCA Bay Area Ras Garba
organizer: Gujarati Cultural Associaton Of Bay Area
long_description:
A Night of Traditional Gujarati Celebration at GCA Bay Area Ras Garba
Mark your calendars for 23rd October 2026, as the Gujarati Cultural Association of Bay Area, or GCA, brings you an evening of vibrant traditional Gujarati festivities at the GCA Bay Area Ras Garba event. Organized by the Aanal & Achal Anjaria Team and Sharda Musical Group, this event is set to immerse you in the heart of Gujarat's rich culture. Experience the joy of Navratri/Dandiya, a multilingual and multi-sensory celebration that is sure to leave you enchanted and uplifted.
Sharda Musical Group: Breathing Life into Tradition
Our event features the renowned Sharda Musical Group who, with their exceptional musical prowess, will transport you to the colorful world of Gujarati folklore. Their profound understanding of traditional music and their ability to infuse it with contemporary elements has made them a favorite among audiences worldwide. Their performance is sure to resonate with each attendee, leaving a lasting impression of the vibrant Gujarati culture.
Experience the Event at the Historic Washington High School
Join us at the Washington High School, located at 38442 Boulevard, Fremont, CA, United States. Known for its safety and accessibility, the location promises an enjoyable and hassle-free experience. With ample parking available, you won't have to worry about finding a spot for your vehicle. After the event, why not explore Fremont's culinary scene? There are several Indian restaurants near the venue where you can relish a variety of authentic Indian cuisines.
Your Access Pass to the Cultural Extravaganza
Make sure you secure your spot at this much-anticipated event. Tickets are available at a General Admission price of $25.00. As we believe in celebrating together, we're offering a special discounted rate of $23.00 per ticket for groups of 8 or more. So gather your friends and family, and join us for an unforgettable night of cultural celebration.
